description: This Java class defines MIDI-related constants and static methods for handling MIDI message bytes, conforming to the MIDI Standard 1.0. It includes byte masks, message status codes, and utility methods for message length determination and activity sensing checks.

classes.name: MidiConstants
classes.description: A utility class providing MIDI constants and methods for byte message handling, according to the MIDI Standard 1.0.

methods.name: getBytesPerMessage
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes that compose a MIDI message based on the status byte.

methods.name: isAllActiveSensing
methods.description: Checks if a sequence of bytes contains only active sensing messages.
